justification: Original frozen quartet; unchanged primary reference.
Replace turaco by cuckoo, another Otidimorphae order (Cuculiformes). Tests order-level P1 representation.
Replace turaco by bustard (Otidiformes), a third Otidimorphae order.
Replace pigeon by sandgrouse (Pterocliformes), a separate Columbimorphae lineage.
Replace pigeon by mesite (Mesitornithiformes), a separate Columbimorphae lineage in the Jarvis/Columbea framework; placement is topology-sensitive.
Replace stork with shoebill, a different waterbird lineage on the non-Otidimorphae/non-Columbimorphae side; broad P3-complement test.
Replace stork with ibis, a different ciconiiform waterbird; broad P3-complement test, not a same-family replicate.
Telluraves representative tests the broad remaining-Neoaves side; treated as an explicit lineage-control, not a close Ciconia substitute.
Combines alternate cuckoo and sandgrouse representatives from distinct orders.
Combines alternate bustard and mesite representatives from distinct orders; mesite placement is topology-sensitive.
Joint alternative representatives across all three ingroup positions.
Original ingroup taxa with predeclared alternative Galliform outgroup; outgroup sensitivity, not an independent quartet.
